managed_browser.license: BSD-3-Clause for Chromium with component-specific notices
managed_browser.qualification: Native Linux x86_64 fixture candidate; clean OS matrix pending
managed_browser.sandbox: Unprivileged user namespaces and Chromium seccomp. No setuid installation is performed. Host must permit the standard namespace sandbox.

managed_wayland_sharing.consent: XDG ScreenCast or RemoteDesktop portal; fresh explicit user selection
managed_wayland_sharing.native_abi: libpipewire-0.3.so.0 >= 0.3.65; matching SPA plugins; build-qualified with 1.6.11

managed_xdmcp.clipboard: Host keyboard with disabled clipboard uses stock Xephyr. An explicit layout or bidirectional clipboard selects the separately pinned session-ready engine. Only bidirectional clipboard opens the parent clipboard endpoint.

clipboard_engine.keyboard: Single registered evdev layout ID, applied to the nested master and KDrive keyboard each generation. Uses the installed xorg-xkbcomp and xkeyboard-config. Host inheritance when omitted.
clipboard_engine.lifecycle: Explicit bidirectional-clipboard option excludes only authenticated local clients with exact live launching-parent PID and UID from XDMCP first-client session ownership; pidfd plus current parent identity retained. All native authorization and ordinary client accounting remain enabled.
clipboard_engine.readiness: display number, then session-ready-v1 after XDMCP session socket selection, then EOF

fixture.scope: Tests only, unshare user/PID/network + private TEST-NET veth + Cage; no PAM login, host display manager or network changes

managed_xdmcp.native_gaps: Private VcXsrv and XQuartz candidate engines require dedicated XDMCP network/authorization adapters and real native qualification. Never automatic installed-client fallback.
managed_xdmcp.network_policy: Default deny. XDMCP requires explicit per-session permission for upstream all-interface inbound TCP. -from only selects advertised/source address; it does not constrain the TCP listener. Never -ac. XDMCP and X11 remain unencrypted and discovery unauthenticated.
managed_xdmcp.status: Linux Arch x86_64 XDMCP candidate; explicit inbound listener policy required; native Windows/macOS unqualified

managed_xwayland.capability_probe_policy: Active native GLX rendering, opaque Composite output composition, RandR screen-size transition and event before releasing clients; no indirect GLX enablement; unsupported libraries, modes and platform providers remain explicit
managed_xwayland.status: qualified Linux x86_64 candidate on the Arch Linux runtime ABI and a Wayland compositor
